name: Volkswagen

summary.text: Volkswagen AG is a German carmaker. On January 11, 2017 the U.S. Department of Justice announced that it had agreed to plead guilty to three felony counts, including conspiracy to defraud the United States and violate the Clean Air Act by using defeat devices on diesel vehicles, and obstruction of justice, and to pay $2.8 billion in criminal penalties plus $1.5 billion in civil settlements. Six executives were indicted. Volkswagen entered its plea in Detroit on March 10, 2017; a 2018 superseding indictment added former CEO Martin Winterkorn.

openQuestions: Site claim (convicted; software on about 11 million cars; US guilty plea 2017; costs over $30 billion): the plea is supported. The 11 million figure and $30 billion total cost were not confirmed from the sources used (site cites WardsAuto).
Outcomes of the individual executives' cases, including Winterkorn, were not researched.
